blocks.goal: Extract the string-joining responsibility (join helpers, the StringJoiner implementation, and the joining Collector) from StringUtil into a new cohesive class to reduce the number of public methods and total methods in StringUtil.

expected_impact.rationale: Moving the join overloads (join(Collection, sep), join(Iterator, sep), join(String[], sep)), the StringJoiner implementation (constructor, add, append, complete) and the joining( String ) Collector removes a cohesive chunk of public API and implementation from StringUtil. This reduces the target class public method count and overall LOC significantly, concentrating join-related responsibilities into a dedicated class.

ops.details: Extract a new top-level class org.jsoup.internal.StringJoiner that contains: 1) the public static class StringJoiner implementation (constructor, add, append, complete) moved from StringUtil; 2) the public static join methods: join(Collection<?> strings, String sep), join(Iterator<?> strings, String sep), join(String[] strings, String sep); and 3) the public static Collector<CharSequence, ?, String> joining(String delimiter). The extracted StringJoiner will use StringUtil.borrowBuilder() and StringUtil.releaseBuilder(StringBuilder) (fully-qualified calls to avoid moving builder pool logic). Remove the moved methods and the inner class from StringUtil. The remaining StringUtil methods (e.g., borrowBuilder/releaseBuilder, padding, whitespace utilities, normaliseWhitespace, resolve, etc.) are left in place.
Add required imports to the new StringJoiner.java: java.util.Arrays, java.util.Collection, java.util.Iterator, java.util.stream.Collector. Ensure package declaration is 'package org.jsoup.internal;'.

Update any references that previously relied on the nested class or join methods inside StringUtil. In particular: remove internal usage of the old inner-type qualifier (StringUtil.StringJoiner) and ensure moved code compiles as a top-level class. Update any references within the moved code to call StringUtil.borrowBuilder() and StringUtil.releaseBuilder(...) explicitly. No external call sites outside these files are modified in this block.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
